answer: Newcomers reach the island only via a referral thread from a member. Entry locks 2x monthly rewards for 20 epochs on the referrer's thread; cheaters cost referrers 15%. Each ember of growth is scanned: star clusters of dozens trigger a fraud challenge, and fraud burns 30% of the bond. N fakes need N deposits plus N co-opted referrers, and flagged clusters burn 30% of bonds; bought accounts fail too, since public edges show the stars.
